name: Sprint Down Memory Lane
source:
Hayabusako, or Haya for short, has always been an athletic woman who never turned down a challenge. Against her parent's wishes, she has tried different sports since a young age and eventually decided to focus on sprinting after joining the Track and Field club in high school.

Despite her love for this sport, she decided to cut her career short while she still had a promising future ahead of her. What could have led her to such a decision? Play this short kinetic novel to see Haya's most important memories and witness the impact family and love had on her life. 

[From [url=https://tenshi-yoru.itch.io/sprint-down-memory-lane]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
隼子，简称隼，一直是一位从不拒绝挑战的运动女性。她不顾父母的意愿，从小就尝试过不同的运动，最终在高中加入田径俱乐部后决定专注于短跑。

尽管她热爱这项运动，但她还是决定缩短自己的职业生涯，因为她的未来仍然充满希望。是什么让她做出了这样的决定？播放这部简短的动态小说，了解哈亚最重要的记忆，见证家庭和爱情对她生活的影响。

[来自[url=https://tenshi-yoru.itch.io/sprint-down-memory-lane]itch.io[/url]]
